heroDesc: Personalized approach from certified artist Svetlana. Safe treatments, premium materials, and a cozy studio designed with your comfort and beauty in mind.
trustSubtitle: I guarantee safety, transparency, and the highest standards of service
trust1Desc: Our sterilization follows a strict 3-stage process complying with sanitary standards: disinfection soaking, pre-sterilization cleaning, and thermal processing in a professional dry-heat oven at 180°C. All tools are kept in sealed sterile kraft bags and opened strictly in front of you.
trust2Desc: All service rates and extra options are transparently listed in our calculator. Before starting, we confirm the final price including any design or nail repair, and this total is guaranteed not to change at checkout. Absolutely no surprise fees.
trust3Desc: We value your schedule and run appointments strictly on time with no waiting area delays. Using proven professional techniques and premium products, we minimize treatment time: a full manicure takes under 1.5–2 hours, and sugaring is fast with minimal discomfort.
servicesSubtitle: Choose category, service, and options — price and duration are calculated automatically.
guaranteeIndicatorText: SVTL Guarantee: You book directly with Svetlana. Master replacement or passing your time to a beginner/trainee is completely excluded. Personal quality control.
guaranteesSubtitle: You are protected by my personal standards of quality
g1Desc: You book directly with Svetlana, a certified and experienced specialist. I personally perform your entire treatment from start to finish and take full personal responsibility for your health, safety, and beautiful results.
g2Desc: We use only certified hypoallergenic gels, base coats, and skin care lotions from top-tier brands. All helper tools like nail files, buffs, sheets, gloves, and spatulas are strictly single-use and disposed of immediately.
g3Desc: Appointments are scheduled with generous buffer times. Unlike big salons, we have zero overlap or rush, ensuring your session starts exactly on time and proceeds in a peaceful, focused atmosphere.
g4Desc: Our pricing menu details the exact cost of every separate operation. Any optional additions (such as gel removal, repairs, or nail art) are discussed and agreed upon beforehand so you always stay in control of your budget.
fearSubtitle: Answering my clients' most common questions
formComfort: The studio is equipped with air conditioning. Fresh coffee, tea, pleasant music, and dedicated service are always included.
formHelp: Fill in your details, and I will contact you on WhatsApp within 5 minutes to confirm your preferred time.
modalSuccessDesc: I'm already preparing to contact you on WhatsApp. See you at your appointment!
careSubtitle: Simple and effective tips to care for your skin and nails after your appointment
